question_revisions_publish_requirements_.name: question_revisions_publish_requirements_check
question_revisions_publish_requirements_.value:
"question_revisions"."status" <> 'published' or (
        jsonb_array_length("question_revisions"."source_refs") > 0
        and "question_revisions"."source_accessed_at" is not null
        and "question_revisions"."reviewer_id" is not null
        and "question_revisions"."reviewed_at" is not null
        and "question_revisions"."rights_type" <> 'unknown'
      )

idempotency_keys_actor_check.name: idempotency_keys_actor_check
idempotency_keys_actor_check.value: ("idempotency_keys"."user_id" is not null) <> ("idempotency_keys"."admin_user_id" is not null)
